name: forma-stack
description: The Forma Stack: the npm workspace of its four packages (packages/) beside the Cargo workspace of its three crates (crates/).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/compiler && npm run build -w packages/build && npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/create-app
scripts.test:e2e: bash e2e/sync-fixtures.sh && bash e2e/ssr/build.sh && bash e2e/frame/build.sh && bash e2e/fixtures/apps/build.sh && bash e2e/skew/build.sh && npx playwright test
